name: @up-coast/beacon-web
description: Beacon for websites: a Report a problem button and form that files bugs, feature requests, change requests and feedback as labelled GitHub issues through the Beacon relay. No GitHub sign-in for the reporter.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --minify --outfile=dist/beacon.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=BeaconWebGlobal --minify --outfile=dist/beacon.global.js && tsc -p tsconfig.json
